_note: VECTOR-PRF -- train-free dense pseudo-relevance feedback on R0's frozen table.

config.source: arXiv 2205.00235, published config, used verbatim -- no grid

verdict: NO SURVIVOR -- train-free query-side post-hoc refinement does not recover the bag-query gap
cost_disclosure: TWO ANN queries per search plus a k-vector fetch, against one for R0. The edge story changes from a single round trip to two, and the feedback vectors must be retrievable at query time.
is_a_system_change: qualifying_system, never qualifying_table: no row changed. Any write-up must decompose it as a retrieval-procedure change.

row.title: VECTOR-PRF -- train-free dense pseudo-relevance feedback on the frozen R0 table
row.registered: 2026-08-29, AFTER D2-PRE and B8 both returned NO SURVIVOR and BEFORE any PRF number of any kind exists. Surfaced by an external adversarial review as the cheapest mechanistically-live lever the plan had missed.
row.question: The table is a BAG of context-free rows; the document tower is contextual. D2-PRE just falsified the hypothesis that finer vocabulary granularity repairs that mismatch. Does one round of dense pseudo-relevance feedback -- pulling the bag query toward the document manifold using the documents themselves -- recover any of it, with NO training and NO change to the document index?
row.lever: q' = normalize(alpha*q + beta*mean(d_1..d_k)) where q is R0's shipped int8 table output at sqrt pooling and d_1..d_k are the top-k document vectors from the FIRST retrieval. Retrieve again with q'. The FROZEN PUBLISHED CONFIG alpha=0.4, beta=0.6, k=3 (Vector-PRF, arXiv 2205.00235) is used verbatim: NO grid, NO tuning, no per-component choice. One configuration, registered before the number.
row.held_fixed: R0's shipped table, byte for byte -- this probe trains NOTHING and changes no row. Teacher, document vectors, document index, pooling rule, precision int8, the frozen convex0 w=0.8 fusion operator. Only the QUERY-TIME PROCEDURE changes.
row.endpoint: PRIMARY and barred: the registered dev group vector at int8/sqrt. SECONDARY and descriptive: the out-of-domain macro, the worst group, and the 4-component fused macro under the frozen operator.
row.comparator: R0's own table under single-pass retrieval, scored in the identical frame in the same process -- a strictly paired comparison in which the only difference is the second pass.
row.bar: mean gain >= 0.0040 on the dev group vector at int8/sqrt. 0.0040 is LEDGER 4.7's planning minimum and it is the RIGHT floor here rather than a conservative one: this probe trains nothing and exact search is deterministic, so there is NO training-seed variance for a floor to measure and the seed-null floor term is exactly zero. The comparison is paired on the identical table, so even table-level noise cancels.
row.multiplicity: ONE frozen configuration and ONE contrast against R0. No family, no Holm, and none is needed. Adding a second (alpha, beta, k) after seeing this number is forbidden: the published config is used precisely so that the probe cannot tune its way to a result.
row.no_survivor: TRAIN-FREE QUERY-SIDE POST-HOC REFINEMENT DOES NOT RECOVER THE BAG-QUERY GAP on this dev suite. Combined with D2-PRE, that closes both the 'finer vocabulary' and the 'refine the query vector after the fact' routes, and leaves document-side co-adaptation (E14-LORA) as the only untested high-capacity lever. It does NOT close a LEARNED feedback encoder (ANCE-PRF and its family use a trained query encoder and are out of scope under E1).
row.is_a_system_change_not_a_table: STATED UP FRONT. This raises no number in the table itself; it is a change to the retrieval PROCEDURE and therefore a `qualifying_system` key under Dylan's 2026-08-29 condition-4 ruling, never a `qualifying_table` one. Any write-up must decompose it as such. It also COSTS: a second ANN query per search plus a k-vector fetch, so the E7 query-side story changes from one round trip to two, and that must be reported beside any gain. Query drift is the known failure mode and a NEGATIVE result is entirely plausible.
row.cost_estimate: Minutes. No training, no re-encoding; one extra retrieval pass over dev corpora already on disk. Components are the outer loop (CODEMAP pitfall 6).
row.exempt_reason: Trains nothing and uses exact search, so the arm is DETERMINISTIC and paired against the identical table: the true-seed-null floor is zero by construction. The planning minimum 0.0040 still binds as the smallest effect this project has ever adopted.
row.plan_status: LIVE -- run after B8, before B10.
